radii.description: Radius of the humeral trochlea about the epicondylar axis: the pulley the elbow flexors and extensors turn over (Wu 2005, 3.3 for the axis)
radii.rule: median distance from the Medial_epicondyle_of_humerus to Lateral_epicondyle_of_humerus axis, over mesh within 22 mm of Trochlea_of_humerus, taking the middle 50% of the distribution

radii.description: Radius of the humeral trochlea about the epicondylar axis: the pulley the elbow flexors and extensors turn over (Wu 2005, 3.3 for the axis)
radii.rule: median distance from the Medial_epicondyle_of_humerus to Lateral_epicondyle_of_humerus axis, over mesh within 22 mm of Trochlea_of_humerus, taking the middle 50% of the distribution

radii.description: Radius of the humeral shaft about the bone's own long axis: what the flexors lie in front of and the extensors behind, rather than passing through (Wu 2005, 2.3.4 for the axis)
radii.rule: 90th percentile distance from the Head_of_humerus to midpoint of Medial_epicondyle_of_humerus and Lateral_epicondyle_of_humerus axis, over mesh within 70 mm of Deltoid_tuberosity
